test_cases.summary:
Verify Default state of Approval Level field
when the user is on the Create Session page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Initialization
The system controls default visibility of Approval Level fields.

Scenario: Default state of Approval Level field

Given the user is on the Create Session page
When the page loads
Then only the Add Level button should be visible and no Approval Level field should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Only the Add Level button should be visible and no Approval Level field should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display Approval Level field on Add Level click
when the user is on the Create Session page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Dynamic Approval Level Addition
The system allows users to add approval levels dynamically.

Scenario: Display Approval Level field on Add Level click

Given the user is on the Create Session page
When the user clicks the Add Level button
Then a new Approval Level field should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
A new Approval Level field should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Add Level button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Add approval levels up to maximum limit
when the user keeps clicking Add Level
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Limit Control
The system restricts the number of approval levels.

Scenario: Add approval levels up to maximum limit

Given the user keeps clicking Add Level
When five Approval Level fields are added
Then the system should not allow adding more than 5 levels
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should not allow adding more than 5 levels
The behavior should be validated when five Approval Level fields are added.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Submit session with empty Approval Level fields
when one or more Approval Level fields are added
test_cases.description:
Feature: Mandatory User Selection Validation
The system validates user selection in approval levels.

Scenario: Submit session with empty Approval Level fields

Given one or more Approval Level fields are added
And no user or group is selected in a level
When the user clicks Create Session
Then a toast message should be displayed saying:
“Error creating session: Each approval level must have at least one user selected”
test_cases.acceptance:
A toast message should be displayed saying:
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Create Session.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Select multiple users in a single approval level
when an Approval Level field is displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: Multiple User Selection per Level
The system supports assigning multiple users or groups per level.

Scenario: Select multiple users in a single approval level

Given an Approval Level field is displayed
When the user selects multiple users or user groups
Then all selected users or groups should be added successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
All selected users or groups should be added successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user selects multiple users or user groups.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Same user added individually and via group
when a user is already part of a selected user group
test_cases.description:
Feature: Duplicate User Conflict Prevention (Individual vs Group)
The system prevents duplicate user assignments.

Scenario: Same user added individually and via group

Given a user is already part of a selected user group
When the same user is selected individually in the same level
Then the system should prevent the selection or show validation
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should prevent the selection or show validation
The behavior should be validated when the same user is selected individually in the same level.

test_cases.summary:
Verify User group added after individual user selection
when an individual user is already selected in a level
test_cases.description:
Feature: Duplicate User Conflict Prevention (Group vs Individual)
The system enforces unique user assignment per level.

Scenario: User group added after individual user selection

Given an individual user is already selected in a level
When a group containing the same user is selected
Then the system should restrict the group selection or exclude the duplicate user
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should restrict the group selection or exclude the duplicate user
The behavior should be validated when a group containing the same user is selected.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Submit session with valid approval levels
when all Approval Levels have at least one unique user or group selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval Level Data Integrity
The system ensures each level has valid and unique users.

Scenario: Submit session with valid approval levels

Given all Approval Levels have at least one unique user or group selected
And no duplicate users exist across individual and group selections
When the user submits the session
Then the session should be created successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The session should be created successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user submits the session.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Open status dropdown on clicking Select Status
when the user is on the Data Labeling page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Data Labeling – Status Dropdown Interaction
As a user, the user wants the status dropdown to open so that filtering options can be selected.

Scenario: Open status dropdown on clicking Select Status
Given the user is on the Data Labeling page
When the user clicks the Select Status field
Then the status dropdown should be opened
test_cases.acceptance:
The status dropdown should be opened
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Select Status field.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display all supported statuses in dropdown
when the Select Status dropdown is opened
test_cases.description:
Feature: Data Labeling – Status Options Display
As a user, the user wants to view all supported image statuses so that correct filtering can be applied.

Scenario: Display all supported statuses in dropdown
Given the Select Status dropdown is opened
When the user views the dropdown options
Then  statuses should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Statuses should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user views the dropdown options.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Filter images using PENDING status
when the Select Status dropdown is opened
test_cases.description:
Feature: Data Labeling – Status-Based Filtering
As a user, the user wants to filter images by PENDING status so that only pending work is visible.

Scenario: Filter images using PENDING status
Given the Select Status dropdown is opened
When the user selects the PENDING status
Then only PENDING images should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Only PENDING images should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user selects the PENDING status.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display no images message for PENDING status
when no images exist with PENDING status
test_cases.description:
Feature: Data Labeling – No Images Handling
As a user, the user wants a clear message when no images are available so that system state is understood.

Scenario: Display no images message for PENDING status
Given no images exist with PENDING status
When the user selects PENDING status
Then a “No images available” message should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
A "No images available" message should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user selects PENDING status.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Tools visibility on image selection
when the user is on the Data Labeling page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Pending Image
The system displays editing tools for selected pending images.

Scenario: Tools visibility on image selection

Given the user is on the Data Labeling page
And an image in Pending status is selected
When the image is selected
Then Annotation button, Invert Color checkbox, Zoom In, Zoom Out, Reset Zoom, Rotate Clockwise, Flip, Pen icon, Brightness control, and Contrast control should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Annotation button, Invert Color checkbox, Zoom In, Zoom Out, Reset Zoom, Rotate Clockwise, Flip, Pen icon, Brightness control, and Contrast control should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the image is selected.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Annotate selected image
when a Pending status image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Annotation Actions
The system allows annotation on pending images.

Scenario: Annotate selected image

Given a Pending status image is selected
When the user clicks the Annotation button
Then the user should be able to draw and mark on the image
test_cases.acceptance:
The user should be able to draw and mark on the image
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Annotation button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Invert image colors
when a Pending image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Color Manipulation
The system supports color inversion.

Scenario: Invert image colors

Given a Pending image is selected
When the user checks the Invert Color checkbox
Then the image colors should be inverted
test_cases.acceptance:
The image colors should be inverted
The behavior should be validated when the user checks the Invert Color checkbox.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Zoom in, zoom out and reset zoom
when a Pending image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Zoom Controls
The system allows zoom operations.

Scenario: Zoom in, zoom out and reset zoom

Given a Pending image is selected
When the user clicks Zoom In, Zoom Out, and Reset Zoom
Then the image zoom level should adjust correctly and reset to default
test_cases.acceptance:
The image zoom level should adjust correctly and reset to default
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Zoom In, Zoom Out, and Reset Zoom.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Rotate and flip image
when a Pending image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Rotation and Flip
The system supports image orientation controls.

Scenario: Rotate and flip image

Given a Pending image is selected
When the user clicks Rotate Clockwise and Flip icons
Then the image orientation should update correctly
test_cases.acceptance:
The image orientation should update correctly
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Rotate Clockwise and Flip icons.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Adjust brightness and contrast
when a Pending image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Brightness & Contrast Adjustments
The system supports visual adjustments.

Scenario: Adjust brightness and contrast

Given a Pending image is selected
When the user adjusts Brightness and Contrast controls
Then the image appearance should change accordingly
test_cases.acceptance:
The image appearance should change accordingly
The behavior should be validated when the user adjusts Brightness and Contrast controls.
